title: Mesh Map
summary: See the LoRa mesh around you: live map, MeshCore chat and a browser dashboard
description:
Mesh Map turns your CardputerZero and Cap LoRa-1262 into a window on the LoRa mesh around you.

• Map: nodes at the positions they advertise, on a dark offline-cached map. Recently heard nodes glow; repeaters are diamonds.
• Scan mode: listens to MeshCore, Meshtastic and LoRaWAN presets in turn and decodes adverts, positions, telemetry and public channels. It never transmits.
• Chat mode: a MeshCore node for the Public channel and your own channels, from the Cardputer keyboard or your phone. It only transmits the messages you send.
• Dashboard: open http://<cardputer>.local:8080 on your phone or laptop for the live packet feed, map, node list and chat. A PIN protects sending and settings.
• Shares the radio: press P to pause, and other LoRa apps such as MeshTerm or MeshCore can use the Cap. If another app holds the radio, Mesh Map says so and waits.

First run: open the dashboard and pick a name, region (Netherlands, EU/UK or USA/Canada) and PIN. Until then the radio only listens.
Keys: arrows pan, +/- zoom, Tab selects a node, C opens chat, P pauses the radio, Shift+Q shows the dashboard QR code.
